decisions.statement: The commit a tree sits at is the one the file git keeps that tree's HEAD in holds.
Reading that commit is one read of one small file rather than a run of git.
A HEAD naming a branch is followed one hop to the file that branch is kept in.
A branch git keeps nowhere loose is read as the line naming it, which never moves.
A commit no file gives back is no commit.
The tree a run came out of is read off the path this module itself was loaded from.
A run loaded from outside every tree came out of no tree.
Code that came out of no tree has moved for nothing any tree does.
The commit a run started at is taken as this module is first imported.
A run leaves on the one exit every long-running unit is written to start again for.
A run says on the way out the commit it started at and the commit it is leaving for.
Nothing here rules on whether the point this is called at is safe.
Nothing here waits, and nothing here does a unit of work.
Nothing here names a kind of tree.

definition: whether the tree a run's code came out of has moved since that run started
